title: Canonical natural comparison for a shift in the right derived tensor factor
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, X an arbitrary scheme, K an object of the ordinary unbounded derived category of small-etale $\Lambda$-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and a an integer. Define the natural isomorphism $(-)\otimes^L K[a]\simeq ((-)\otimes^L K)[a]$ [def-kun-derived-tensor] by the commutation of left tensor by the variable object M with the shift a, evaluated at K. Naturality in M is the compatibility of the derived tensor bifunctor with shifts in each variable. This is the ModuleCat(Lambda) specialization of the existing source-library derivedTensorRightShiftIso.
